title: Aftercare Engagement and Extension Days under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, aftercare engagement moves the days an extension of an approved authorization adds.

## Records consulted

The individual outpatient behavioral health visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines, counted over the last three months and over the last twelve months.

## Determination

1. Where three or more outpatient behavioral health visits of the patient are dated in the last three months, **1 day is taken off** the extension.
2. Where none is dated in the last twelve months, **1 day is added**.
3. Otherwise nothing changes.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Visits in the last 3 months | Visits in the last 12 months | Change to the extension |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 4 | 1 day taken off |
| 1 | 3 | none |
| 0 | 0 | 1 day added |
